mapper.sql: o.id, o.parent_id, o.org_type, o.name, o.path, o.depth, o.status
u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.account, u.employee_no, u.org_id, o.name AS org_name, o.path AS org_path, u.company_id, u.position, u.status AS user_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.id = #{orgId} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.name = #{name} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY o.id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.org_type = #{orgType} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY o.id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.org_id = #{orgId} AND l.leader_type = 'primary' AND l.category IS NULL AND u.status <> 'resigned' ORDER BY l.sort_no ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.org_id = #{orgId} AND l.leader_type = 'deputy' AND l.category IS NULL AND u.status <> 'resigned' ORDER BY l.sort_no ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.org_id = #{orgId} AND l.category = #{category} AND l.leader_type = 'primary' AND u.status <> 'resigned' ORDER BY l.sort_no ASC, l.id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_user, alias=u) */ AND u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_user, alias=u) */ AND r.code = #{roleCode} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'active' ORDER BY u.id ASC
